remarks: SHORT TERM FURNISHED RENTAL IN WONDERFUL WATERFRONT COMMUNITY! Just bring your suitcase! This quiet completely renovated home is superbly situated, only 3 min walk to beach yet only 5 min drive to South Norwalk train station. It is flooded with light and offers EXPANSIVE VIEWS of Long Island Sound and its ever changing tidal wildlife. Upstairs features a gracious open floor plan including living/dining/kitchen area with fireplace, and generous family room all creating easy living and entertaining spaces.  Enjoy the panoramic views from 2 decks with outdoor shower and gas grill. Garage accommodates 2 smaller cars or 1 large car. This waterfront community boasts a beautiful white sand beach, 2 tennis courts, park, playground and a new deep water dock. The museums, boutiques and restaurants of SoNo are minutes away! New Pickleball courts just outside of Village Creek! Available October 2024-April 2025
